learning_outcomes.text: Students learn methods and technical expertise to master design tasks for complex and innovative machines and products.

syllabus_topics: Machine Elements 3: important components (e.g., welded joints and gears) for complex machines
Selection, design, and functional installation of components
Calculation methods for dimensioning and testing components for function, strength, and service life
Holistic development and design of complex and novel machines, considering additional aspects (e.g., lightweight construction, manufacturing-friendly design, specific knowledge from other lectures)
Deepening knowledge from previous lectures on machine design and Innovative Product Development 1
Experience in technical-scientific project management and technical documentation
Design exercise 2: application of acquired knowledge from design theory and known machine elements
Time planning, requirement definition, conception, and constructive design of a moderately complex, innovative machine
Presentation of technical development results in several discussions
Documentation in a written final report

assessment_methods.method: graded written exam of 60 min duration for the course Machine Elements 3 (MABB431)
ungraded semester-long study project for Design Exercise 2 (MABB432)

assessment_rules: The graded written exam for Machine Elements 3 (MABB431) determines the module grade. The study project for Design Exercise 2 (MABB432) is an ungraded semester-long study work, completed in small groups. Active participation in the project and several milestone meetings, as well as submission of a final report, are mandatory for passing the study project, but it does not contribute to the module grade.
